active.summary: Reliable routine setup is temporarily paused.
active.impact: Requests to create, schedule, monitor, remind, post later, or keep work updated should not create live routines.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not create new live routines. Prepare the requested routine shape and offer useful one-time work now.
active.workaround: Capture the routine plan with schedule, condition, delivery, and workspace or Slack target so it can be turned on later.
avoid: Do not say the routine is scheduled or running.
Do not ask the person to retry routine setup repeatedly.

active.summary: Slack reinstall and web widget setup are degraded.
active.impact: If Slack was uninstalled, reinstall may not complete and the web setup widget may not work.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not tell people to uninstall and reinstall Slack as the fix. Do not rely on the web widget when this status applies.
active.workaround: Use web-only work where possible, draft Slack messages instead of posting them, and route reconnect cases to Motion support or an operator.
avoid: Do not claim the widget can finish the reconnect flow.
